import cv2,hashlib,json,pathlib,numpy as np
source=pathlib.Path('/tmp/rdk-b7-5fc14a4/samples/vision/bytetrack/test_data/bus.jpg')
image=cv2.imread(str(source)); assert image is not None
output=pathlib.Path('/tmp/rdk-b7-bytetrack-motion4.avi')
assert not output.exists()
h,w=image.shape[:2]
writer=cv2.VideoWriter(str(output),cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'FFV1'),10.0,(w,h)); assert writer.isOpened()
frames=[]
for dx in (0,2,4,6):
 frame=cv2.warpAffine(image,np.array([[1,0,dx],[0,1,0]],dtype=np.float32),(w,h),flags=cv2.INTER_NEAREST,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=(0,0,0))
 writer.write(frame); frames.append(hashlib.sha256(frame.tobytes()).hexdigest())
writer.release()
cap=cv2.VideoCapture(str(output)); actual=[]
while True:
 ok,frame=cap.read()
 if not ok:break
 actual.append(hashlib.sha256(frame.tobytes()).hexdigest())
cap.release(); assert actual==frames
record=dict(purpose='Synthetic four-frame motion smoke, not real-video tracking accuracy',source=str(source),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),video=str(output),video_sha256=hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),codec='FFV1',fps=10,translations_x=[0,2,4,6],frame_shape=list(image.shape),frame_sha256=frames)
pathlib.Path('/tmp/rdk-b7-bytetrack-motion4.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record))
